Name: (SVE) Stardew Valley Expanded Anime Portraits
Author: m4gnolia
Description:
An anime-style portrait overhaul for [b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b] that replaces the custom villagers with detailed, handcrafted pixel art designed to fit right into the game's aesthetic.

[b]Choose Your Version :[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Non-Seasonal:[/b] Perfect if you prefer standard portraits while keeping all alternate roles and outfits (like Joja employees, theater staff, and vendors).[/*]
[*][b]Seasonal:[/b] The full package featuring custom sprites tailored for different seasons and special events.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Latest Changelog :[/b]

[list]
[*][b]New Portraits Added:[/b] Added new portraits for Mermaid, Wandering Trader, Lance, and Isaac.[/*]
[*][b]Minor Updates:[/b] Refreshed and polished existing portraits for Andy, Susan, and Alesia.[/*]
[*][b]Version Split:[/b] Now available in two separate options to fit your preference: [b]Non-Seasonal[/b] or [b]Seasonal[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[b]Key Features :[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Fresh Anime Aesthetic:[/b] Completely redesigned portraits that bring a vibrant, expressive feel to every conversation in the valley.[/*]
[*][b]Full Outfit Variety:[/b] Dedicated sprites covering standard looks, Joja uniforms, and vendor outfits.[/*]
[*][b]Simple & Clean:[/b] Built with Content Patcher for smooth, hassle-free installation.[/*]
[/list]-
[quote][b]Note on Missing Characters:[/b] If a specific SVE character isn't included in this mod, it's because other creators have already made fantastic anime portraits for them! Feel free to mix and match with other mods out there.[/quote]
Big thanks to:

[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister[/url] - Creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfit -Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url].

[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ohodavi?gameId=1303]Ohodavi[/url] - Heavily inspired by their work.
